title: SOLV Energy | SOLV Energy Highlights Growing Customer Demand for…
summary: We are the leading EPC contractor and O&M provider in the U.S, delivering solar solutions that generate good energy for people and the planet.
body_markdown:
LAS VEGAS, Nov. 16, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- As utilities, developers and asset owners invest in the infrastructure needed to meet growing power demand, SOLV Energy (NASDAQ: MWH) continues to expand its role as a full-lifecycle infrastructure services provider supporting customers across construction, operations, maintenance and asset optimization.


RE+ 2026 marks SOLV's first appearance at the industry's largest clean energy conference since becoming a publicly traded company earlier this year.


"The need for reliable, scalable power continues to grow, creating opportunities across every stage of the energy asset lifecycle," said George Hershman, Chief Executive Officer of SOLV Energy. "Customers are looking for partners that can deliver projects successfully and support long-term asset performance. From engineering through operations, maintenance and repowering, SOLV is uniquely positioned to meet those needs."


SOLV continues to see strong demand for large-scale energy infrastructure projects across North America, with average project size now exceeding 400 MWdc, resulting in a robust backlog of $9.2B as of September 30, 2026, with the Southwest, South-Central and Midwest regions driving growth.


Long-term relationship-building remains a key focus for SOLV, with a majority of our customers utilizing multiple SOLV service offerings, including EPC, O&M, technical services and high-voltage solutions. SOLV customers are also focused on maximizing their assets’ performance through operations, maintenance, storm repairs, plant restoration and repowering services, which we perform through our energy infrastructure lifecycle approach.


Recent investments, including the[acquisition of ASB Energy Services](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=C5EgZ1PmdyJCOqo8W6FJ0LHJommelfh3RQRLFsWSIlxf5zeZ_dfLTP9kB0fcCe1Bg_aMNqY87rbg8IenHDeHEUHwFG63aUW35kC1m_8qYxs4IlAA6HGlDjCVugNmQqchmRngxnvKE6oWRzNkpB-XxvhcEADsSQtzS4sYNrGZRv46H-T276Kx6g10BEoOgqMNm15DN4_1VXiEhR6OEI_2IlgS4zWx6H9L52ExZ8Qs8OfHrNZAVwAYo5O3x9gjROqoTiUgua2gCk9X0g2P2tejMQ==) , expand SOLV's capabilities across the energy infrastructure lifecycle. The transaction enhances SOLV's ability to support transmission, distribution, high-voltage and field services work while strengthening its position as a long-term infrastructure partner.


“We're seeing customers take a longer-term view of their infrastructure needs,” said Helena Kimball, Chief Revenue Officer of SOLV Energy. “Rather than evaluating projects one at a time, many are looking to establish relationships with partners they trust and can scale with over time. That includes everything from new-build projects to operations, maintenance, repowering and other services that help maximize long-term asset value.”


As part of the conference program, George Hershman will join a fireside chat hosted by SEIA on Nov. 17 to discuss the future of power infrastructure and the opportunities and challenges shaping the industry, including energy storage, data center growth and the need for resilient, scalable energy solutions.


**About SOLV Energy**


SOLV Energy (Nasdaq: MWH) is a leading provider of infrastructure services to the power industry, including engineering, procurement, construction, testing, commissioning, operations, maintenance and repowering. Since 2008, we have built over 24 GW of generating capacity. SOLV Energy also provides operations and maintenance (O&M) services to over 24 GW of generating capacity. In addition to EPC and O&M for utility-scale power plants and related T&D infrastructure, we offer large-scale repair, emergency response and repowering services and install end-to-end SCADA and network infrastructure solutions to maximize project performance and energy availability.
